name: St Peter's Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:St Peter's stands on the site of the church founded by St Wilfrid, who died in Oundle in 709. Its spire, 210 feet high, is the tallest in Northamptonshire.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Oundle is one of the oldest named places in the county: Wilfrid's monk Eddi wrote of it as Undolum in about 715.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The church tower door has been forced. Scratched on the stone beside it is a message, written backwards.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The backwards message]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who does the message name? (surname)]]
hints: [[c:Start at the end of the line.]]
[[c:The first word backwards is a name.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It reads HERE WAS GANT. Someone saw Josiah Gant at the tower door.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:A message by the tower door names GANT.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 60 metres as the crow flies, to Oundle School's buildings by the church.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
